Could you help me out with these improvements please @lebaphi: 
* [x] we're missing the icon for `marker-shadow.png` (see console)
* [ ] I don't want to re-create the array of renderers on each new message/features update. Do you think we can supply the `features` object down in the TSX? 
![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/1108513/16801e01-2e84-4935-966e-bdc1c75eebe2)
* [x] our two renderers are going to override some GeoJSON behaviours.  Currently, they just have distinct `filter` behaviours.  But, I don't want that logic in this class.  I'd like it in two child classes, in a `renderers` sub-folder. Could you refactor it please?  I _guess_ each class could **extend** `GeoJSON`.

Hi @IanMayo , I pushed a small changes of creating some renderer classes, can you review it :D
> I don't want to re-create the array of renderers on each new message/features update. Do you think we can supply the features object down in the TSX?

yep, I think so.

Thanks for the refactoring. It's almost what I was looking for.  But, I'd like to avoid re-creating the renderers when we get a new message (features).  Really, we only need to generate the renderers on a `channel` update.

Is there a way where we pass the `features` object down in the TSX?  Then we're not re-creating the renderer, we're just updating a prop.

issues.title: TSX API for Core Mapping
issues.body:
Come up with TSX API for the mapping component.

Consider:
- things it has to know about: 
    - current force/role
    - current turn
    - current phase
    - FeatureCollection 
    - channel definition
    - ForceStyle data (names/colors)
- things it must provide:
    - list of asset ids/names
